title: Two Views of the Compromise
goal: I can contrast two views with *viszont* and *noha* (*Deák hívei elfogadták, Kossuth viszont …*).
I can name the words of the debate on the Compromise (*Cassandra-levél*, *reálpolitika*, *nemzeti szuverenitás*).
I can write one sentence that contrasts two views.
